name: revit-bimwright
description: Connects Claude Code to an installed BIMwright rvt-mcp server (v1.2.x) for Revit 2022-2027 with the full tool catalog (about 250 tools, 50+ for creating walls, structure, foundations, rebar, MEP, rooms, views and sheets). Arbitrary C# execution is switched off. Requires the BIMwright setup on the same Windows machine.
